name: Klippan to Helsingborg, the same road only good
description: Rated good, the 17 km parallel road is worth riding with the default 40 % budget, but its west end is reached over 5.5 km of 100 km/h road. Since 2026-09-26 (dull fast roads) the route joins it further on over 60-80 km/h roads instead: part of the favourite, no 100 km/h road, curvier, a few minutes longer. A great rating (case 05) still rides all of it.
